record.question: The most sensitive indicator of community health status is:
record.explanation: Answer B: Infant mortality rate. Infant mortality rate is a sensitive population-level indicator reflecting maternal, infant, environmental, and health-service conditions. Source/context note: No single indicator fully summarizes community health; “most sensitive” is a textbook convention. Reference: https://www.who.int/data/gho/indicator-metadata-registry/imr-details/1. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
